about: Which config.json keys spell each field, in the order they are tried. The one copy both config readers use: crit_core.model.config loads it, core/CMakeLists.txt generates the C++ reader's arrays from it. A model family that spells a field its own way adds its key here, never a branch in a reader. layer_count_from: per-layer lists whose length is the layer count when num_hidden_layers is absent (configs that derive the count from them).
